Class DefaultScene

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.scene.DefaultScene
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class DefaultScene extends Object implements Scene
The DefaultScene provides a visually appealing experience for ziviDomeLive, featuring dynamic animations and interactivity.

  • Method Details

    • setupScene

      public void setupScene()
      Description copied from interface: Scene
      Sets up the scene when it becomes active.

      A scene may be activated more than once. Each activation after a switch follows a corresponding Scene.dispose() call.

      Specified by:
      setupScene in interface Scene

    • update

      public void update()
      Description copied from interface: Scene
      Updates mutable scene state for the current Processing frame.

      Use this callback for simulation, animation counters, timelines, physics, state transitions and mutable randomization that must advance once per frame. Keep those mutations out of Scene.sceneRender(PGraphicsOpenGL) when all rendered views/faces must observe the same state.

      Specified by:
      update in interface Scene

    • dispose

      public void dispose()
      Description copied from interface: Scene
      Disposes resources used by the scene. This method is called when an active scene is switched, cleared, replaced, or released by the facade. By default, it logs the transition. Override this method if a scene requires custom resource management.
      Specified by:
      dispose in interface Scene
